text: The bullet didn't kill President Garfield. His doctors did.
In eighteen eighty one, a gunman shoots the president, and somehow, he survives.
Then doctor after doctor digs for the bullet, with bare, unwashed fingers.
Alexander Graham Bell, the telephone guy, rushes in with a metal detector.
But the head doctor only lets him search the right side.
And the metal springs in the bed make the machine buzz anyway.
You see, the bullet itself was harmless. His body had already sealed it off.
Most historians think the real killer was the germs on all those dirty fingers.
Seventy nine days later, the infection killed the president.
And the bullet? It was on the left side, the one place nobody was allowed to look.
